domains.title: Terminal core and fixtures
domains.focus: Parser to TerminalOp to Terminal::ingest; InputEvent encoding via handle_input and drain_input; single logical writer per presented terminal; golden fixtures and assert_fixture.

domains.title: Terminal presentation and rendering
domains.focus: TerminalView and TerminalRenderCache; route_input into an application-owned EncodedInputSink; the UI performs no session I/O; Direct2D and software rendering paths.

domains.title: Sessions, PTY, serial, and persistence daemon
domains.focus: Session, SessionEvent and SessionLifecycle contract; backend implementations; sessiond mirror_terminal_output is the intentional backend-owned recovery terminal; SessionController and pump_session_events; terminal_replies_owned_by_backend prevents duplicate replies.

domains.title: SSH transport, trust, and SFTP
domains.focus: SshSession and host-key trust policy; TransferManager owns the SFTP queue; integration and interop evidence.

domains.title: Configuration, workspace, and secrets
domains.focus: Config and workspace store metadata and opaque CredentialReference values only; SecretStore owns secrets; file-security helpers.

domains.title: Application commands, tabs, and input routing
domains.focus: AppCommand, dispatch and AppState are the canonical action route; widgets must not hold product policy; keyboard capture and bindings.

domains.title: Automation, workflows, and MCP
domains.focus: Broker owns automation authority; FrozenInvocation binds workflow inputs; MCP Machine owns protocol state, not transport or authorization; a connection is not a grant; staged qualification.

domains.title: Documents, editor, and Markdown
domains.focus: TextDocument owns shared document state; Markdown loading and projection; syntax highlighting bounds; UI actions route through AppCommand.

domains.title: Terminal recording and export
domains.focus: Recorder capture, ExportBackend workers, platform encoders, and recording privacy.

domains.title: Dev tunnels, enterprise, and PowerShell
domains.focus: Tunnel discovery and HostBinding; rooted FileService and Filesystem; distinct trust and consent boundaries; helper artifact Manifest verification; gated qualification.

domains.title: Desktop platform integration and packaging
domains.focus: macOS window and menu integration, power and resume notifications, updater and packaging, native smoke evidence; platform paths are not interchangeable.

domains.title: Mobile hosts (iOS and Android)
domains.focus: Shared mobile runtime host; offline-by-default fixture and opt-in live SSH prototype; native evidence gates; Android JNI boundary.

domains.title: Desktop application shell and screens
domains.focus: Application startup, the egui app loop, screens and panes, diagnostics, and how the shell wires sessions, commands, and rendering together.
